title: Advanced age.
bodyText: An individual shall not be involuntarily subjected to the provisions of this part solely based on advanced age.
bodyHtml: [§346-252]  Advanced age.  An individual shall not be involuntarily subjected to the provisions of this part solely based on advanced age. [L 1989, c 381, pt of §1; am L 1990, c 144, §1 and c 234, §9]
